If "BIG BANK PAYDAY" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
2413.headline: The prize table, line by line

2414.body:
The most common win left on "PREMIER PLAY" is $100. The second biggest prize left is $100,000, and four of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

Today's free summary of "PREMIER PLAY" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
2414.headline: A close look at the prizes

2415.body:
"Double The Money" has gone close to two months without a top prize claim, and tickets kept selling. Only a fixed number of tickets are printed. About half of the tickets are sold, and every remaining $100,000 prize is still unclaimed. That leaves the same top prizes among fewer tickets.

Every line of Double The Money's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
2415.headline: Top prizes have lasted so far

2416.body:
About two-thirds of the tickets for "Loaded with $2,000s" have been sold. The game is past the halfway point of its run. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, the top prizes and the tickets are going at about the same pace.

The table below shows the full count for "Loaded with $2,000s", with every prize level included.
2416.headline: Where this game is in its run

2419.body:
A $2,777 top prize on "Bronze 7s" was claimed in this morning's update. The game started with four top prizes and has one top prize left. The prize table has today's count for every prize level.

If you play "Bronze 7s" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
2419.headline: The top prize list got shorter

2420.body:
One of Silver 7s's top prizes was claimed earlier this week. A player in Virginia won $177,777. The game started with three top prizes and now has two top prizes. Nothing bigger can change on a scratcher.

If "Silver 7s" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
2420.headline: Top prize count went down

2421.body:
"Gold 7s" has 211,067 prizes of $10 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $7,000 prize, with nine left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

Everything here about "Gold 7s" comes from official Virginia lottery numbers, current through October 22.
2421.headline: A close look at the prizes

2422.body:
Platinum 7s's prizes make it a game with most of its money in small, frequent prizes. Of the prize money still unclaimed, about two-thirds is in wins under $2,000. The prize counts change every day, but this design does not.

If you play "Platinum 7s" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
2422.headline: How the prize money is divided

2426.body:
"HAUNTED HUNDREDS" has 3,533 of 5,340 top prizes left and is in the middle of its run. About a quarter of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, tickets and top prizes are running out at about the same rate.

The numbers for "HAUNTED HUNDREDS" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
2426.headline: Where this game is in its run
